title: Only 5 Players Have Won 3+ Ballon d'Ors. Who's Next?
audience: Football fans 13-35, casual viewers before the ceremony
whyCare: The 70th Ballon d'Or is on Oct 26 in London; records are the safest, most chartable angle (Messi 8, Ronaldo 5, Cruyff/Platini/van Basten 3).

evidence.claim: 2026 Ballon d'Or: 70th ceremony, 26 October 2026, London; season 3 Aug 2025 - 19 Jul 2026
All-time wins: Messi 8, Ronaldo 5, Cruyff, Platini, van Basten 3 each; 2025 winner Ousmane Dembele
Wikipedia 'Ballon d'Or' averaged 5,113 views/day Oct 1-19 2026, ~6,000/day in the last 3 days (rising into the ceremony)

competitors.title: WHAT 5 PLAYERS HAVE WON THE MOST BALLON D'ORs (Short)
Race to Ballon d'Or...Mbappe vs Haaland (S2G / CaniSports)

angle: Bars chart cascades 3 -> 3 -> 3 -> 5 -> 8 with years on each bar; stat counter: 70 editions since 1956; close on 'will anyone new reach three?' (no winner predictions). Publish Oct 25-26; update pinned comment after the ceremony.
hook: In 70 years, only five players have won the Ballon d'Or three times or more.
strengths: Pure records = low defamation risk; bars scene ready-made; hard-deadline traffic
weaknesses: Same week as the existing 'How the Ballon d'Or is decided' Short - put them on different days; football Shorts are crowded; football +1 policy risk for clip temptation
